city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je umerenog kvaliteta; osetljive grupe mogu osetiti blagi uticaj.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem tvrdnju Observera da se razmak između prijema smanjio: trenutno je od prijema građanskih senzora prošlo 11 min, a parkinga 21 min, što samo po sebi ne potvrđuje trend smanjivanja. Odbacujem i raniju početnu vrednost parkinga: prikazano poređenje sada je 63 prema 412, a ne dokaz talasa odlazaka kojem je upravo utvrđeno vreme. [F3][F4][F5]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Observer’s claim that the reception gap has narrowed: the current ages are 11 min for citizen sensors and 21 min for parking, which alone establish no narrowing trend [F3][F4]. I also discard the earlier parking baseline: the displayed comparison is now 63 to 412, not evidence of a newly timed departure wave [F5][F4].
